name: timone
description: Orchestrator agent and knowledge skills (memory, code intelligence, docs lookup, planning, verification) for structured plan-then-build development workflows.

context7_api_key.title: Context7 API key
context7_api_key.description: Optional Context7 API key for higher documentation-lookup rate limits. Leave empty to use the free tier.

orchestrator_model.title: Orchestrator model
orchestrator_model.description: Model used by the top-level orchestrator agent for planning and delegation. Valid values: "sonnet", "opus", "haiku", "fable" (family aliases) or a full model id (e.g. "claude-sonnet-5"). Family aliases resolve to whatever Anthropic currently recommends for that family and CAN CHANGE on a later release (e.g. "opus" has meant different pinned versions over time) — to pin an exact version such as Opus 4.5, Opus 4.6, or Sonnet 4.6 instead of "whatever sonnet/opus currently means", type its full model id here (e.g. "claude-opus-4-6", "claude-sonnet-4-6") rather than the alias. Run `/model` with no argument in a Claude Code session to see the exact model ids available to your account before picking one. No dropdown is available for this field — type the value exactly.
